checkpoint_finding.declared_corpus: K562, HepG2, and WTC11 human lentiMPRA
checkpoint_finding.weight_identity: Git LFS SHA-256 and size are exact, but bytes were not acquired

interpretation: MPRALegNet is a useful HepG2 reporter-activity comparator, not an endogenous regulatory-effect model. Its ALT-minus-REF score can test whether a learned MPRA prior transports to MASLD variants, but the base model has no donor context, treatment context, enhancer-gene link, or signed eQTL/ieQTL target. The exact HF output file predates GSE281364 but postdates the other two GEO releases; target-label unexposed, not globally clean, is the defensible overall classification.
known_incidents_and_biases: The checkpoint is a third-party Hugging Face repackaging and has not been matched to the author Zenodo model archive.
The filename identifies one test1_val2 model, whereas the author study used ten-fold cross-validation.
HepG2 is a transformed hepatoblastoma line and does not supply LX-2, donor, or MASLD tissue context.
A 230-bp genomic window is a domain-transfer input, not the original lentiMPRA construct distribution.
Reverse-complement averaging can stabilize orientation but does not create treatment or cell-state conditioning.
remaining_blockers: Obtain campaign approval before acquiring the exact safetensors file, then verify its LFS SHA-256, size, tensor keys, shapes, and dtypes without network access during load.
Either prove equality to an author Zenodo checkpoint or explicitly freeze acceptance of the third-party artifact and its lower provenance confidence.
Pass the Python 3.11, PyTorch 2.0, CUDA, BatchNorm eval-mode, forward, reverse-complement, determinism, and cross-device tolerance probes on L40S.
Freeze and fixture-test 230-bp oligo and genomic-window construction, allele index, REF match, N handling, strand restoration, and SNP-only admission.
Activate GSE281364 only after its variant-barcode-oligo joins, counts, condition labels, replicate structure, QC, and rights pass; never treat replicate libraries as donors.
Keep any enhancer-gene link and signed-effect direction rule as a separately registered composite frozen before sealed inference.
